name: Verified Denmark Copenhagen loop
inferred: Exact Google section distances were allocated in proportion to the official matched-path classes.
Operational mapping: Highway = signed motorway; Country = non-motorway outside built-up-area signs; City = non-motorway inside built-up-area signs.
unresolved: 9.001 km of short ramps and local connectors did not pass conservative official-network distance and snap checks.
The legal source does not prescribe a universal GIS mapping for every country's road attributes.
method: Long sections named by Google (E20, E47, 22, 14 and 21) were matched to the official numbered-road network. Official signed-road-type and general-speed-regime attributes were then joined to those paths. Short sections were accepted only when the official-network distance differed by no more than max(50 m, 5%) and both anchor snaps were no more than 100 m. All remaining distance stayed unresolved.
official_sources: Danish road and path register regulation: https://www.retsinformation.dk/api/pdf/177057
